format_revisions.change: First EPUB and paged HTML reading editions.
Revise authorship and audit credits, include per-edition revision identifiers and record digests for both publication formats.

Wrap uninterrupted cipher sequences in reading paragraphs. EPUB also groups long colon-separated numbers at their separators so narrow readers can retain every digit. EPUB tables with six or more columns use compact cell spacing and type.
Print the canonical colophon URL once, retain the addresses of labelled links and keep the metadata together across print page breaks.
